listNote: The official PlayStation 5 trophy list: 55 trophies — 1 Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver, 46 Bronze — 28 of them hidden, 1,000 Gamerscore in total. Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are as PlayStation publishes them, cross-checked across the published lists named in the sources.

sources.name: Output Lag — GTA 6 trophy list guide

trophies.guide: The platinum, and the finish line of everything below it. It unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are earned, so it is never a task by itself — work the roadmap and it arrives last. Published estimates put the full completion near 200 hours, so pace the grind rather than sprinting it.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing the story mission Gone Fishing, early in the opening chapter. Story trophies cannot be missed: follow the campaign and it pops as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 of the story. Unmissable — and guides note a chapter trophy can pop as the next chapter begins rather than the moment the last mission ends, so do not worry if it lands a few minutes late. Before leaving Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation described under Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 of the story. Unmissable. Chapter 2 is also when several side systems open up — the Scooter Bros app and garage buying among them — so it is a natural point to start exploring between missions.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 of the story. Unmissable. A Chapter 3 mission (Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) also hands you the tool the Sneakthief trophy needs, so the story is pulling double duty here.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 of the story. Unmissable. Keep an eye out for the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is — it opens the bank vaults that Maximum Withdrawal needs.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Before you start it, save in a manual slot: the endgame is the point of no return, and there is no New Game+, so a pre-finale save is the safety net that keeps every open-world cleanup available afterwards. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter for the same reason.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — and worth paying attention to, because the story's heists teach the robbery systems that several free-roam trophies reuse.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Unmissable. Remember the airport layout — the Catch Me If You Can trophy sends you back there.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: The real endgame. After the story, the full checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — and progress made earlier still counts, so nothing is wasted. The published breakdown is a wide sweep: all robberies including 8 bank vaults and 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every shooting-range gold, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks in full, plus partial shares of the big counters — 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work this last, checklist open.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: GTABase 100% completion breakdown; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — the marked jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps spread across Leonida. Published counts put 397 stunts in the world, so you can skip the hardest ones and still finish comfortably. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so every stunt here does double duty.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: fishing, drone racing, car racing, the shooting ranges, arcade games, bowling, hunting, meditation and gym training, per the published activity list. One attempt at each is enough — and several of those first tries also feed other trophies, so do this early.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Get gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges, spread across 12 ranges on the published list. Ranges also appear in full on the 100% checklist, so clear each range completely the first time you visit instead of planning a return trip.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy; the fuller set of 42 drone races belongs to the 100% checklist instead, so save the repeat races for the endgame.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Keep one fast car registered and upgraded as your racer, and clear race markers as they appear so the wins spread across the playthrough instead of piling up at the end.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is the fishing contact; take his challenge once fishing is unlocked and land the better catch. Time on the water is not wasted — fishing also counts toward Master of None and the animal study totals.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Cabinets sit in arcades and bars around Leonida; finishing a game, rather than just starting one, is what counts. A quick detour whenever you pass a cabinet.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Andy's stranger strand. Stranger missions appear as question-mark markers; work the chain to its end whenever you pass one. Note that some strands feed Strangers & Freaks and some do not — check that trophy's counter as you go.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Kenton's stranger strand — the boat-themed chain. Follow his markers through to the last job.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Billy's stranger strand. Follow his markers through to the end of the chain.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers — but not every strand counts. Published guidance names the strands for Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete as counting toward this trophy, while several named character chains (Andy, Billy and Tyrone among them) reportedly do not. Watch the trophy's own progress counter and prioritise the strands that move it.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Randy's stranger strand. Follow his markers through to the end of the chain.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of Tyrone's stranger strand. Follow his markers through to the end of the chain.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the one trophy to plan around. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots. One spot is story-linked: during Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen and accept her balcony meditation. That spot is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and guides note it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it — do it anyway; it costs two minutes. Meditating with both characters at a spot counts twice toward the 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Start his missions early and keep them moving: Bret's hunting line also runs the Target Deck hunts that the 100% checklist wants in full, so his work counts twice.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida and gathered into themed sets; sweep them up as you explore each area rather than leaving every set to an endgame hunt, when the missing few are hardest to find.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK scanning feature at 100 different locations. The 100% checklist counts 100 WAiNK scans as well, so a habit of scanning as you travel covers both trophies at once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the short tracked tasks the game lists in its menus. Fifty earns this trophy, but the 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, so keep going past 50 if A Long Road is on your roadmap.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape. A bank-vault robbery reliably raises 4 stars, so this pairs naturally with a Maximum Withdrawal run: rob the vault together, then break line of sight, swap vehicles if you can, and stay hidden until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with partner without losing Wanted Level
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without the wanted level dropping in between. Plan a short route of nearby shops first, keep your partner close, and move fast enough between robberies that the stars never fully clear.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by getting in or scanning them as you meet them. Vehicle scans also feed the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of 277, so make a habit of trying every unfamiliar car, boat and aircraft rather than walking past.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Save the ability for a crowded fight — a gang operation or a heist escape — and line up five quick takedowns before the effect runs out.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a passenger jet parked at a boarding bridge — published guidance points to gates E3 and E4 — take off, and fly roughly a kilometre away for the trophy to pop.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: The description is the clue: it is hot inside a Rhino. Rhino tanks are military hardware, and published guidance places them at Mile Zero Air Station, at the south end, and on the southwest island. Approach carefully — expect serious resistance around them.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The clean method arrives with the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which provides the Snap Gun: use it on the store's back door — kicking the door trips the alarm — then find the safe-code note in the back room before you touch anything. Published guidance names Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds as a good target.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The vaults open up through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, and 5 of the 8 vaults are enough. Bring your partner to help carry the take, and expect a 4-star wanted level on the way out — which also sets up Hot Together on the same run.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The trucks appear in free roam; block or disable one, take the cash, and break away cleanly until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — visit every region of the map. This usually finishes on its own late in a completion run; if one corner is missing at the end, sweep the map edges, the islands and the far shore by car, boat and plane.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. The 100% checklist counts 39 gang operations in total, so clearing one per gang early finishes this trophy and leaves the rest for the completion sweep.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger has been published yet, and this guide will not invent one. The description's plain reading: buy or accept a cocktail at an Ocean Beach bar with a view of the water and see if it pops. If it does not, later community guides will pin it down — check the sources.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list (trigger unconfirmed)

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style
trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger has been published yet. The description's likely reading is stealing a car from a showroom and driving it out through the glass — treat that as a guess to try, not a confirmed method, until a source verifies it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list (trigger unconfirmed)

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley
trophies.guide: Published guidance ties this to the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn, which is also a gang operation during Chapter 2: clear it and search inside for three valuables — a luxury watch, a shotgun and an office safe (sticky bombs open the safe).
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Published guidance reads this one as raising Strength to maximum for both Jason and Lucia. Train at gyms with your partner present — training together raises both characters at once, which halves the grind.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: PlayStation tracks a count of 500 for this trophy: published guidance reads it as 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile, which accumulate across a normal playthrough. One caution from the same guidance — avoid pushing the profile all the way to its permanent Irredeemable state.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: PSNProfiles progress count, via GTABase; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger has been published yet, and this guide will not guess one into steps. It has the shape of a fail-and-retry event; as community guides confirm it, the sources below are where the answer will appear.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list (trigger unconfirmed)

trophies.guide: No confirmed trigger has been published yet. The description suggests a hidden event or encounter rather than a tracked task, so no steps are published here — inventing them would help nobody. Watch the sources for confirmation.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list (trigger unconfirmed)

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by
trophies.guide: Bowl enemies over with a melee drive-by: ride or drive past a group and strike them with a melee attack from the vehicle. No fuller trigger has been published yet, so experiment near a crowd of enemies until it pops.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw and the total builds steadily across the whole playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothing, vehicles, weapons and services all count toward the running total, so this usually lands during a normal completion run; if it lags behind, vehicle and property spending closes the gap fast.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, for roughly $160,000 in total on published figures — and garages the story hands you do not count toward the 8.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives with Moses' Chapter 2 mission; register stolen cars after a respray, and keep a free garage space so a registration is never blocked.
trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.sources: GTABase trophy list; Output Lag trophy list
